svg.title: open-pokered architecture: platform entry points, game orchestration, game logic & presentation, content data, and the external engine
svg.desc: Desktop, Web, Android and iOS orchestrate core logic, UI, rendering and audio through pokered-app's PokemonGame; TUI uses its own orchestration while reusing lower-level modules. pokered-data provides data and build-time compiled scene scripts. The editor previews and playtests via WASM, and a TCP debug server supports automated verification. Each module depends on the external dotzuki engine by responsibility.
svg.text: A Rust game reimplementation · shared game logic connecting multi-platform play, content editing, and automated verification
Based on current source & Cargo deps
Input dispatch → state advance → frame & audio
game.rs · render/ · audio/ · save I/O · link transport
Boundary: game rules & state; no platform output
Game score + SFX tables; device output per platform
Static tables · embedded assets · runtime override
JSON / .scene / .gui → static Rust tables, scene ASTs, layout data → embedded at runtime
Default scene execution: native AST interpreter; Boa is the script-boa dev / fallback path.
Layers shown by responsibility; only primary relationships kept — see the companion Mermaid source for full crate deps.
Maps · story · data · UI · saves · pixels
Local API / disk · static mode / IndexedDB
State reads · input injection · deterministic frames
Script checks / config gen · data extraction
Each layer depends on dotzuki-* by responsibility
Effect stack / state API / DSL compile & interpret
Engine modules omit the dotzuki- prefix; pokered-* crates hold game-specific code.
